name: PocketCurator
summary: Manages a user's own ROM collection from an EmulationStation-style interface.

notes: Rechecked 2026-10-24: stable v1.1.2 ZIP matches the publisher sidecar and GitHub digest: 5903925 compressed bytes, 19915921 regular-file bytes, 211 files and 21 directories. No duplicate paths, traversal, absolute paths, or special-file entries were found.

Authorized upstream-managed experimental installation. The Store verifies and extracts the original ZIP into a private PocketCurator directory under Ports, keeping the launcher beside pocketcurator as upstream requires. It does not run an installer. Settings stay through repair, update and removal; unrelated Ports files are never adopted.

ROM deletion is an intentional upstream feature with a confirmation screen. Back up ROMs and scraped media before using it. App runtime writes are not sandboxed by the Store. Fetch only content you have the right to use from a server you trust; the Store supplies no ROM provider.

The packaged updater and netsync download executable code outside Store transactions. PC_SKIP_UPDATE only skips launcher application of staged updates; it does not disable these downloads. The launcher can also acquire and mount a PortMaster runtime.

Upstream-managed mode leaves the app's updater and PortMaster runtime acquisition available under the user's control. These are not Store-verified updates. Current PortMaster is required; system Python/pygame is preferred on Knulli. Close the app before Store operations. No exact device test is claimed.

evidence.note: Downloaded stable ZIP SHA-256 bb1907289bb5e22c6d24c39b9fae6dac0c17b75821a6565d77fcba3cce9af664 matches the publisher sidecar and GitHub API digest. ZIP CRC and entry inspection passed. Only the inspected deletion module was exercised with disposable files; no launcher or installer was executed.

Packaged netsync.py downloads .sh/.zip/.py over HTTP into the parent Ports directory after a developer-network DNS gate. Packaged updater.py conditionally checks a publisher checksum; neither path uses Store transactions.
MIT project license and bundled dependency notices reviewed.
Upstream lists TrimUI Smart Pro, but does not tie that claim to Knulli, v1.1.2, or a lifecycle result.

install.warning: Untested. Requires current PortMaster. App controls runtime downloads and updates. ROM deletion is permanent: back up first. Fetch only content you may legally use. Close app before Store operations; Repair restores pinned code. Settings stay after removal.
